C1.reason: The strategic content is fully captured by equilibrium analysis of the bargaining game; there is no separate manipulation or strategyproofness result that would warrant SB as a main result type.

C2.2.reason: Proposals are divisions of a resource and votes are binary yes/no, so neither is a cardinal score or utility submitted by voters, and OTH alone fits.

C3.1.reason: Every theoretical analysis models proposals and votes as strategic equilibrium choices, and the experiment rule calls for ALL when subjects choose their inputs freely.
